title: The Stem That Carried a River
intro: This quiz follows Lina and Mateo as they discover how a plant's stem transports water, minerals, and food.

questions.prompt: Why was the sunflower drooping after the hot morning?
choices: It had received too much sunlight
It needed more water
Its roots had disappeared
Its flower was too heavy
questions.explanation: The sunflower was drooping because it needed more water.

questions.prompt: What did the blue-water flower experiment demonstrate?
choices: Water moves upward through the stem
Flowers make blue water
Roots change the color of petals
Leaves send water into the soil
questions.explanation: The blue-water flower experiment demonstrated that water moves upward through the stem.

questions.prompt: What is the job of the xylem?
choices: To carry food from the leaves
To produce seeds
To carry water and minerals upward from the roots
To attract insects to the flower
questions.explanation: The xylem carries water and minerals upward from the roots.

questions.prompt: What is the job of the phloem?
choices: To carry food made in the leaves to the rest of the plant
To soak up water directly from the air
To hold the plant firmly in the soil
To make sunlight for the leaves
questions.explanation: The phloem carries food made in the leaves to the rest of the plant.

questions.prompt: Why is the stem compared to a transportation system?
choices: It allows the plant to move from place to place
It carries water, minerals, and food to different parts of the plant
It produces all the plant's flowers
It protects the plant from every insect
questions.explanation: The stem is like a transportation system because it carries water, minerals, and food to different parts of the plant.
